prompt: A volunteer changes the arrangement in one corner. The label cards are still readable in the previous close photograph. How should this morning’s setup be recorded?
promptZh: 志工調整了一個角落的排列。前次拍的近照仍看得清標示卡。這天上午應如何記錄布展？

options.text: Log “same layout” because the card text did not change.
options.zh: 登記為「配置相同」，因為卡片文字沒有改。
options.whyZh: 即使舊近照仍看得清卡片文字，牆面一角改動也不能填「配置相同」。

options.text: Keep only a new wide picture of the wall.
options.zh: 只保存一張新的展牆全景照。
options.whyZh: 即使只改一角，也要保存兩張照片。

options.text: Keep a new wide picture and a new close picture of the cards.
options.zh: 保存一張新的全景照及一張新的卡片近照。
options.whyZh: 牆面一角有改動，不能走無變更的例外；仍須保留全景和卡片近照。

options.text: Keep only the old close picture because it shows the readable details.
options.zh: 只保留前次近照，因為細節可讀。
options.whyZh: 前次卡片近照無法記錄改後的排列，也不符合改動時拍兩張的規則。

explanationZh: 牆面一角有改動，不能走無變更的例外；仍須保留全景和卡片近照。
evidence: volunteers will take two photographs for the setup record: a wide view of the wall and a close view of the label cards. / Take and keep a new pair even if only one corner of the wall has changed.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: volunteers will take two photographs for the setup record: a wide view of the wall and a close view of the label cards.
Take and keep a new pair even if only one corner of the wall has changed.

vocabulary.note: 指靠近物件拍出的畫面，便於閱讀細節。
